name: Default Privacy
description: Agent-readable discovery root for the Default Privacy hub: a free, searchable directory of privacy tools plus guides, curated tool stacks, a glossary, and free privacy diagnostics. Exposed to agents as an MCP server and a read-only REST API.

capabilities.name: dp_search
capabilities.description: One keyword search across directory tools, guides, stacks and the glossary; the starting point for a general privacy question.

capabilities.name: dp_search_tools
capabilities.description: Search the privacy tool directory with structured filters. Picks first, then A to Z.

capabilities.name: dp_get_tool
capabilities.description: Retrieve one tool's full Privacy Protocol record by slug.

capabilities.name: dp_list_categories
capabilities.description: List directory category groups and subcategories with tool counts.

capabilities.name: dp_find_alternatives
capabilities.description: Replace a mainstream app or service (Gmail, WhatsApp, Chrome…) or a website tracker with privacy-respecting alternatives; for apps, also what switching involves and the related guides and stacks.

capabilities.name: dp_how_private
capabilities.description: How private an app or service is: Default Privacy's own record, private replacements, ToS;DR's dated grade of its terms and privacy policy, and the vendor's own privacy policy.

capabilities.name: dp_get_related_tools
capabilities.description: List other tools in the same category as a given tool slug, DP picks first, then A to Z.

capabilities.name: dp_compare_tools
capabilities.description: Compare 2–5 tools side by side by their full Privacy Protocol records.

capabilities.name: dp_search_guides
capabilities.description: Search long-form privacy how-tos: switching to GrapheneOS, home address, data-broker removal, your own VPN, and more.

capabilities.name: dp_get_guide
capabilities.description: Fetch one guide by slug: its sections and short FAQ answers, one section, or the full text.

capabilities.name: dp_list_stacks
capabilities.description: List curated privacy stacks: sets of directory tools for one goal or threat.

capabilities.name: dp_get_stack
capabilities.description: Fetch one privacy stack by slug: its layers and tools in setup order, one section, or the full text.

capabilities.name: dp_route
capabilities.description: Pick 1 to 3 situations from a fixed list and get the guides and stacks to read for each.

capabilities.name: dp_check_mcp_server
capabilities.description: Check an MCP server against Default Privacy's vetted list: what it can touch, or a checklist if unlisted.

capabilities.name: dp_search_glossary
capabilities.description: Search the privacy and security glossary.

capabilities.name: dp_get_glossary_term
capabilities.description: Fetch one glossary term's full definition by slug.

capabilities.name: dp_check_email_security
capabilities.description: Check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC posture for a domain.

capabilities.name: dp_check_whois_privacy
capabilities.description: Check WHOIS/RDAP records for exposed personal identity fields.

capabilities.name: dp_check_domain_breaches
capabilities.description: Check whether a domain appears in known public data breaches.
